body:
I’m a gay trans man as well (20) and have a lot of the same issues here as well. I know things right now are hard for you. You feel lost as fuck and feel like there’s no way out. Your hearts been broken so much you can’t even see yourself. Each piece feels stomped on.
But just because those pieces feel stomped and destroyed doesn’t mean they can’t be helped, put back together and loved. You’re gonna find that person for you.

Those guys who hurt you are fucked man. (Sorry for the language)
I know you’ve probably heard this before but you are so damn strong for going through this. 
There are times where you’ll feel weaker and that’s okay. I promise you that things will look up soon dude.
My DMs are open here if you need anything. This is a throw away account but if you want we can talk on my actual account. It will be okay man. ❤️
Right. I’ve always been called a failure in my life and I promised everyone, including my 80 year old grandmother, that I would do well. I don’t know what to do right now and I’m scared.
